set.body: From AddPanel (p0-addpanel 41886c21). With New figure plus Add panel, the board's templates arrive as panels C–G, not Figure 1's exact A–E, because no control removes or reorders panels. Add Remove panel and Move panel controls (undoable, keyboard-reachable), then convert the golden journey's remaining CreateFigure bypass.
set.title: Figures: controls to remove and reorder panels
